implementedInteractions.detail: Real filtering over authoritative fields only (roomNo/location/address/propertyType/description/highlights for text search; location/type/price-band/area-band for structured filters). Desktop Filter and mobile FilterDrawer share one RentalFilterState so they can never drift. Apply updates results + closes the mobile drawer; Reset restores all results to page 1; any filter/search change resets pagination to page 1; result counts reflect the filtered set. Homepage SearchPanel selects the same real options and navigates to /cho-thue with only the supported params picked.

q/location/type/price/area/page persisted via router.replace (no history spam from typing) — /cho-thue and /tin-tuc both survive reload and are deep-linkable. Verified in a real browser via Playwright e2e (tests/e2e/rental-url-state.spec.ts): reload persistence, deep-link reconstruction, and back-navigation after a homepage search.

"Tìm bài viết..." now filters title/category/excerpt/section headings, combines with the existing category-button filter, resets pagination on change, and syncs q/category/page to the URL the same way as rentals. Empty state reuses the one approved empty-result visual (EmptySearchResults) instead of a second invented one.

Proper tablist/tab/tabpanel semantics (role, aria-selected, aria-controls/aria-labelledby), roving tabindex, and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End keyboard support. Same visual buttons and filtering behavior as GĐ4 — only added operability.

aria-current="page" on the active nav link (desktop nav + mobile drawer), matched by path prefix so nested detail routes still mark their section current. No approved active-nav visual state exists in state-map.json/layer-map.json, so this is semantics only — no new color/underline/weight invented.

Found and fixed a real pre-existing bug: the lightbox never locked body scroll while open (FilterDrawer and Header's mobile nav already did). Added the same lock-on-open/restore-on-close pattern. Left focus trap, Escape, and Left/Right navigation untouched — they already worked.

implementedInteractions.area: Admin Sidebar mobile drawer — bug fix
implementedInteractions.detail: Same missing-scroll-lock bug found in the admin mobile nav drawer during the Task 08 audit sweep and fixed identically. Existing focus trap/Escape (useFocusTrap) and aria-current were already correct. Accessibility/regression fix to an existing drawer, not new admin functionality — within the GĐ5 admin allowance.

Already had first-invalid-field focus, aria-invalid, and aria-describedby from GĐ4 — verified and locked in with tests, plus added coverage for keyboard (Enter) submission and repeated-empty-submit safety. Remains frontend-only: no email/API/DB/lead storage added, per GĐ6 scope.

Verified app/globals.css already matches interactions.json exactly (transition-duration: 120ms cap, animation-duration near-zero under prefers-reduced-motion) and duration-fast/duration-base (140ms/220ms) are the only transition tokens in use. Left untouched — no new animation added.

"Số phòng ngủ" was not wired to any filtering logic. It remains the approved visual control with zero real options beyond the placeholder — never inferred from propertyType, parsed from description, or fabricated. data-source-map.json was not modified.

resolvedInReopenPass.topic: Mobile FilterDrawer had no real Apply/Cancel semantics — every field change committed straight to shared state/URL on change, so Escape/X/backdrop couldn't discard anything.
resolvedInReopenPass.fix: FilterDrawer now owns a local draft, re-seeded from committedFilters on every closed→open transition. Field edits and "Xóa bộ lọc" only touch the draft; only "Áp dụng" calls onApply(draft), which the page wires to setFilters (commits to shared state/URL, resets to page 1), then the drawer closes itself. Escape/X/backdrop just close — draft discarded, re-seeded fresh next open. Desktop Filter unchanged (still applies live). No visual change — state-management only, 0 diff bytes vs the GĐ5 baseline for /cho-thue MOBILE + WEB.
resolvedInReopenPass.testsAdded: 6 new FilterDrawer.test.tsx cases (Escape/X/backdrop discard, Apply commits, re-seed-on-reopen, Xóa bộ lọc stays draft-only) + tests/e2e/rental-filter-drawer.spec.ts (5 specs) exercising the same flows against a real browser/production build.
